summary: Adds default source filesystem verification to checkpoint resume views and refactors the destination-specific rev0678 probe into a shared manifest-filesystem checker for source and destination-after manifest roles.
heart_of_mission: Evidence-bound peer-to-peer folder convergence: authorized devices should converge on intended folder content while stale, forged, drifted, or incomplete restart evidence is rejected or surfaced explicitly.
audit_findings: Rev0678 made terminal resume evidence destination-filesystem-aware but left source manifest rows as database-only evidence.
A future recovery executor needs live source truth as well as live destination truth before using checkpoint rows as restart input.
The destination checker was product-correct but role-specific; adding source verification was the right point to refactor it into a shared manifest-filesystem probe.
implementation_changes: Added source_filesystem_* counters and source_filesystem_drift_paths to SyncSessionCheckpointResumeViewResult.
Refactored SyncDestinationFilesystemProbe into SyncManifestFilesystemProbe and verify_manifest_filesystem_or_throw.
load_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_view now probes source rows under source_root_path and destination_after rows under destination_root_path.
terminal_session_complete now requires source_filesystem_verified and destination_filesystem_verified when the respective strict options are enabled.
The focused sync-domain selftest now mutates source bytes after checkpoint commit and verifies strict rejection plus advisory drift reporting.
resume_filesystem_checks: source manifest rows are checked under source_root_path by path, kind, size_bytes, and content_sha256
destination_after manifest rows are checked under destination_root_path by path, kind, size_bytes, and content_sha256
file rows reject missing files, symlinks, directories, non-regular substitutions, size drift, and SHA-256 drift
tombstone rows are treated as absent-path expectations
strict mode rejects drift; advisory mode leaves the resume view loadable while reporting bounded drift paths

honest_ceiling: Does not replay checkpoint rows into resumed work.
Does not persist in-flight request/schedule/batch state before each crash point.
Does not own abandoned staged transfers or cleanup recovery policy.
Does not yet model tombstone/conflict branches inside the fake peer session.
Does not define peer/folder trust material or encrypted/authenticated transport.
